title: Fine-water-mist extinguishers
text: Developed for use on the ISS, with practical applications on Earth.

title: Smoke detection
text: A 1970s shuttle smoke detector that tells smoke from dust, giving fewer nuisance alarms. It has industrial uses, such as in mining.

title: Firefighter air tanks
text: Spacesuit technology adapted in the 1970s to improve firefighters' air tanks and breathing gear.

title: Firefighter clothing
text: Spacesuit technology applied in the 1980s to improve firefighter protective clothing.
source_label: NASA Spinoff: New Technology for the Fire Attire
